appDescription: A car karaoke stage. While the car is parked, the cabin lights, climate and seats react to the occupants singing along to music played by another app.

function.name: OPEN_STAGE
function.description: Opens the karaoke stage so the car reacts to the user's singing. Use when the user wants to sing, start karaoke, or open the stage.

function.name: START_BATTLE
function.description: Starts a two-person singing battle between the driver seat and the front passenger seat. Available only while the car is parked.

function.name: FINISH_SONG
function.description: Ends the current song and shows the finale with the excitement score.
